focus: D2 security - spec-kit hooks and trust boundaries

findingDetails.title: The completion-evidence sentinel source contains a raw NUL byte, making the file binary to search and diff tooling
findingDetails.evidence: Byte 16206 is a raw 0x00 inside the dedup hash-seed template literal; rg reports binary file matches instead of lines; diff prints Binary files differ; file says data; git still renders text because the byte is past the 8000-byte sniff window. Same defect pre-exists at rubric-guard.cjs:59 (present at v4.0.0.2).
findingDetails.recommendation: Write the separator as the escape sequence in both files so the source stays ASCII; the runtime hash input is unchanged.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Scanned every source-like file under the four focus trees for NUL bytes (two hits), read both sites in place, confirmed rg/diff/file behavior, and confirmed the sentinel's NUL arrived with its first in-range commit.

direction: The spec gate can be silently disarmed by a crafted environment
reason: Deny is opt-in under exact SYSTEM_SPEC_GATE_ENFORCE=1; kill switches are documented operator surfaces; child bypass requires AI_SESSION_CHILD exactly 1 (spec-gate-core.mjs:79-106,1754-1758).

direction: A leaked enforce env can deny a dispatched session
reason: isChildSession short-circuits to allow before any state read or telemetry (spec-gate-core.mjs:1755-1758).

direction: The deny surface is wider than the contract says
reason: Deny only for write/edit, only while the gate is open and unanswered, never for exempt targets; bash only advises (spec-gate-core.mjs:142,1774-1793).
